name: Verify Before Trusting
description:
Extract `configs.zip`. The approved file has SHA-256 `ce066393e2e00862a06ead85ba0fd49114179a3ecb95fc78746bd3f33b038566`. Find its filename and submit `SCSS{filename}`, including the extension.

Submit exactly one flag in `SCSS{...}` format. Flags are case-sensitive.
